messages.content: What is the dominant genetic trait of a Lion?

message.content: In lions, one of the most well‑known dominant traits is the presence of a mane in adult males. The gene that controls mane development is inherited in a dominant fashion—if a male lion inherits the dominant allele from either parent, it will develop a mane. This trait is often used as a classic example of dominance in mammalian genetics.
